answer: Every claim climbs the sparrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the nadir re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, published publicly on failure, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the atlas of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
